thread:
maya (PM): Proposed rollout plan: dark-launch regionally (EU + us-west), tenant opt-in buckets, A/B for quality vs latency, and a clear degrade/rollback ladder. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

sam (EngLead): +1. want explicit gating metrics. propose: latency P95 < 200ms, error rate < 0.5% relative increase, and quality regression (BLEU/embedding-similarity) within 1.5% of baseline.

li (Infra): for EU we need a warm node pool. suggest warm pool size = 10% of expected traffic per slice, auto-scale buffer +20%. otherwise cache misses will spike.

nina (SE): customer ask: some tenants want opt-in by org, others by user flag. we should support tenant-level flag plus runtime override for users. do we have that in flag schema?

sam (EngLead): yes, flag supports hierarchy: org > route > user. config snippet: ```json
{"flag_name": "new-embed-routing", "scope": ["org:ORG_ID", "user:USER_ID"], "buckets": [{"id":"control","pct":90},{"id":"variant","pct":10}], "start": "auto"}```

alan (SRE): add operational triggers: if tail latency (99.9) increases by >20% for 5m OR error rate doubles for 1m => auto-fallback to baseline model. also add circuit-breaker to pause variants per region.

maya (PM): agree. propose A/B sequence: 1) 1% tenant-level opt-in (non-critical customers) 24h smoke, 2) 5% mixed tenants 48h with telemetry, 3) 10% broad A/B 72h. at each step require signoff or automated gate pass.

kevin (Sales): customer-facing ask: some enterprise customers need a permanent opt-out until SLA confirmed. we must offer an org-level pin that disables variants and logs compliance.

carla (Legal): confirm data residency for EU opt-ins. if variant routes to a model hosted outside EU, we need consent or to host EU-only variant. pls document.

li (Infra): we can host EU-only variant as a quantized variant on eu-n1 pool. cost delta estimate ~ +12% for EU traffic.

nina (SE): telemetry: please capture token-per-request, prefix cache hit rate, avg latency, model_score_delta (embedding cosine vs baseline), and sample outputs every 1k requests to eval harness. we need a dashboard tile per slice.

sam (EngLead): will add alerting thresholds in Ops config. sample rule: if model_score_delta drops below -2% and human-labeled regression rate >1% => fail gate.

maya (PM): rollback hierarchy: soft-fallback (route new users to control, keep existing sessions on variant) -> hard-fallback (all traffic to baseline) -> emergency kill (feature flag off). timeline for each: soft: immediate, hard: within 2 min, kill: manual confirmation.

alan (SRE): implement automated soft-fallback on metric breach, but require human ack before kill. add runbook link and a simple command for operators: `/runbook rollback new-embed-routing --scope region=eu` (deploy-bot will log).

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: dark-launch EU/us-west at 2026-04-02T06:00Z -> starting canary slice (1%). CI checks: unit + integration + telemetry hook verified. :shipit: 

maya (PM): outstanding items: 1) deck for sales + legal (carla, kevin) 2) ops dashboard and alerts (alan, sam) 3) flagging UI change for tenant pin (nina, li) 4) cost impact doc for EU variant (li) 5) signed off gating thresholds (everyone). aim to finalize by EOD Friday.

kevin (Sales): I'll own the customer deck and pin workflow comms.

carla (Legal): I'll draft residency language and constraints. need list of any external providers used by variant.

sam (EngLead): I'll push the gating PR and add test harness for the quality regression check. assign to @nina for verification.

nina (SE): ack. i'll prepare sample prompts for eval harness and a short guide for customers to opt-in/out.

alan (SRE): i'll add the circuit-breaker + auto-fallback rules and the alert runbook.

li (Infra): will surface cost delta and resize warm pools, and confirm EU-only hosting config.

maya (PM): perfect. if anyone hits blockers DM me. we'll reconvene Tues morning for final signoff. :calendar: 

sam (EngLead): quick Q — how strict is the 1.5% quality threshold? can we make it metric-specific? e.g., embedding-sim better tolerance than generative BLEU?

maya (PM): yes, make thresholds per metric. default: embedding-cosine tolerance = -2%, token-gen BLEU = -1.5%, but we'll tune per experiment. update the PR with per-metric fields.

kevin (Sales): FYI a large EU customer asked to run the variant only on internal staff for 2 weeks before org opt-in. do we support that?

nina (SE): yes — we can scope by user list (user flag) and run an internal cohort. place them in the 100% variant bucket for that org-id.

maya (PM): noted. final ask: include a brief postmortem template for each step in the runbook so we capture learnings. thanks all.
